mentions.title: McLaren to upgrade MCL40 F1 car at its bogey track Las Vegas
mentions.summary:
McLaren will introduce upgrades to its MCL40 at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix, with the new parts labelled as “the foundation for next year’s car”.
The team launched its 2027 front wing concept in Brazil, with team principal Andrea Stella describing it as an improvement for driveability and predictability; McLaren returned to form at Interlagos, with Lando Norris clinching pole ...Keep reading

mentions.title: FIA reveals ADUO results in final review of 2026 F1 season
mentions.summary:
The FIA has announced its final Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) results for the 2026 Formula 1 season, with no changes granted for any of the power unit manufacturers.
From this season, the FIA installed a mechanism in the F1 regulations which allowed power unit manufacturers the ability to make updates, if they fell behind the leading engine, in the form of tokens ...Keep reading

mentions.title: Russell explains why he chose not to use Mercedes’ turbo upgrade in Las Vegas | Formula 1
mentions.summary: George Russell isn't using Mercedes' new turbo this weekend because he would have to take another grid penalty.
